items.card_text: Admissions, fee reminders and parent updates for schools and coaching.
items.title: WhatsApp for Education: Admissions & Updates
items.h1: WhatsApp for education: admissions, fees and parent updates
items.description: How schools, colleges and coaching institutes use WhatsApp for education: admission enquiries, counselling, fee reminders, class updates and results.
faqs: Can schools message parents in bulk on WhatsApp?
Yes, with the parents' opt-in and approved templates. Class updates and fee reminders usually fall under the utility category.
Can the bot answer admission questions after hours?
Yes. It can share fees, courses and deadlines at any hour and book a counselling call for the next day.
Is student data safe?
Messages are encrypted in transit, and access in the inbox is limited by role. Share only what each message needs.

items.card_text: Catalogs, cart recovery, order updates and returns on WhatsApp.
items.title: WhatsApp for Ecommerce Stores
items.h1: WhatsApp for ecommerce: from browsing to repeat orders
items.description: WhatsApp for ecommerce covers product discovery, cart recovery, COD confirmation, order tracking, returns and repeat purchases. Here is a practical setup.
faqs: Can WhatsApp reduce COD returns?
Confirming cash-on-delivery orders on WhatsApp before dispatch helps filter fake or impulse orders, which lowers return-to-origin rates.
Which store platforms connect?
Shopify, WooCommerce and most custom stores can send order events to WhatsApp through webhooks or an app.
Should order updates be marketing or utility?
Order confirmations and delivery updates are utility messages. Offers and new arrivals are marketing.

items.card_text: Lead capture, document collection, renewals and payment reminders.
items.title: WhatsApp for Finance & Insurance Firms
items.h1: WhatsApp for finance and insurance: leads, documents and renewals
items.description: How banks, NBFCs, brokers and insurers use WhatsApp for finance: lead qualification, KYC document collection, EMI and premium reminders, and claims updates.
faqs: Can customers send KYC documents on WhatsApp?
Yes. Customers can share photos or PDFs in the chat, and the files can be saved straight to your system. Delete copies you do not need to keep.
Is WhatsApp allowed for financial services?
Yes, but WhatsApp's commerce policy limits some products, and your regulator's rules still apply. Get compliance sign-off on templates.
Can premium reminders include a payment link?
Yes. A utility template can carry a secure payment link from your gateway.

items.card_text: Appointment booking, reminders, reports and follow-ups for clinics.
items.title: WhatsApp for Healthcare Clinics
items.h1: WhatsApp for healthcare: bookings, reminders and patient follow-ups
items.description: WhatsApp for healthcare helps clinics and hospitals book appointments, send reminders, share reports and run follow-ups, while protecting patient privacy.
faqs: Can patients book appointments on WhatsApp?
Yes. A flow shows doctors and open slots, confirms the booking and adds it to your calendar or hospital system.
Can we send lab reports on WhatsApp?
Many clinics do, after the patient opts in. A secure download link is safer than sending the file itself.
Can the bot give medical advice?
No. The bot should handle bookings and general information only, and send any medical question to qualified staff.

items.card_text: Test drives, service bookings and reminders for dealers and workshops.
items.title: WhatsApp for Automobile Dealers
items.h1: WhatsApp for automobile dealers: test drives, service and renewals
items.description: How car and two-wheeler dealers use WhatsApp for test drive bookings, quotes, service reminders, insurance renewals and delivery updates.
faqs: Can buyers book a test drive on WhatsApp?
Yes. The bot asks for the model, location and time, confirms the slot and alerts the sales executive.
How do service reminders work?
Your DMS or CRM shares the due date, and WhatsApp sends a reminder with a link or button to book the slot.
Can we share brochures and price lists?
Yes. PDFs, images and short videos can be sent in the chat or attached to a template.

items.card_text: Instant replies to property leads, site visits and brochures.
items.title: WhatsApp for Real Estate Leads
items.h1: WhatsApp for real estate: faster replies to property leads
items.description: WhatsApp for real estate helps builders and brokers qualify property leads, share brochures, book site visits and nurture buyers until booking.
faqs: Can WhatsApp capture leads from property portals?
Yes. Leads from portals and ads can be pushed to WhatsApp so the buyer gets a reply within seconds.
Can we share project videos on WhatsApp?
Yes. Videos, floor plans and location maps can be shared in the chat.
How should we follow up with slow buyers?
Send useful updates, such as construction progress or new launches, once or twice a month rather than daily pushes.

items.card_text: Support tickets, demos, renewals and status alerts for IT firms.
items.title: WhatsApp for IT Services Companies
items.h1: WhatsApp for IT services: support, demos and renewals
items.description: How IT and SaaS companies use WhatsApp for demo bookings, support tickets, outage alerts, renewal reminders and onboarding checklists.
faqs: Can WhatsApp create support tickets?
Yes. A message can open a ticket in your helpdesk, and status changes can be sent back to the customer on WhatsApp.
Is WhatsApp suitable for B2B?
Yes. Many decision makers prefer a quick WhatsApp reply to a long email thread, especially for demos and renewals.
Can we send outage alerts?
Yes, as utility templates to customers who have opted in to service alerts.

items.card_text: Registrations, reminders, links and follow-ups for events.
items.title: WhatsApp for Events & Webinars
items.h1: WhatsApp for events and webinars: registrations to replays
items.description: WhatsApp for events and webinars: take registrations, send joining links and reminders, share tickets and replays, and collect feedback after the event.
faqs: Do WhatsApp reminders improve webinar attendance?
They usually help, because WhatsApp messages are seen faster than email. Send one a day before and one shortly before the start.
Can we send QR tickets on WhatsApp?
Yes. A template can carry the ticket image or a link that opens the QR code.
How do we collect feedback?
Send a short rating question with buttons after the event, then ask one open question.

items.card_text: Enquiries, itineraries, bookings and trip updates for travel firms.
items.title: WhatsApp for Travel & Tourism Businesses
items.h1: WhatsApp for travel and tourism: enquiries, itineraries and trip support
items.description: How travel agents, tour operators and hotels use WhatsApp for travel: enquiries, quotes, itineraries, payment reminders, trip alerts and reviews.
faqs: Can travellers get help on WhatsApp during a trip?
Yes. WhatsApp works on Wi-Fi abroad, so travellers can reach your team without roaming calls.
Can we share itineraries as PDFs?
Yes. Itineraries, vouchers and tickets can be sent as documents in the chat.
How do we collect balance payments?
Send a utility reminder with a payment link a set number of days before travel.

items.card_text: Run WhatsApp for clients: campaigns, reports and white-label work.
items.title: WhatsApp for Marketing Agencies
items.h1: WhatsApp for marketing agencies: running WhatsApp for clients
items.description: How marketing agencies can offer WhatsApp to clients: account setup, click-to-WhatsApp ads, campaigns, chatbots, reporting and pricing the service.
secondary: click to whatsapp ads for clients
faqs: Who should own the WhatsApp account, the agency or the client?
The client. Their business portfolio should own the number and templates, and the agency should get partner access.
Can agencies run click-to-WhatsApp ads for clients?
Yes. The ads run from the client's ad account and open a chat with the client's WhatsApp number.
How should agencies charge for WhatsApp?
Most charge a setup fee and a monthly retainer, and pass Meta's message charges through at cost.
